arxiv-2211-00515.title: Infinite-Dimensional Adaptive Boundary Observer for Inner-Domain Temperature Estimation of 3D Electrosurgical Processes using Surface Thermography Sensing
arxiv-2211-00515.creator: Hamza El-Kebir, Junren Ran, Martin Ostoja-Starzewski, Richard Berlin, Joseph Bentsman, Leonardo P. Chamorro
arxiv-2211-00515.description: Abstract We present a novel 3D adaptive observer framework for use in the determination of subsurface organic tissue temperatures in electrosurgery. The observer structure leverages pointwise 2D surface temperature readings obtained from a real-time infrared thermographer for both parameter estimation and temperature field observation.

arxiv-2411-09327.title: Slowly rotating and charged Black-holes in Entangled Relativity
arxiv-2411-09327.creator: Maxime Wavasseur, Théo Abrial, Olivier Minazzoli
arxiv-2411-09327.description: Abstract Entangled Relativity is a non-linear reformulation of Einstein’s General Theory of Relativity (General Relativity) that offers a more parsimonious formulation. This non-linear approach notably requires the simultaneous definition of matter fields, thus aligning more closely with Einstein’s principle of relativity of inertia than General Relativity does. Solutions for spherically charged black holes have already been identified.

pmc-10628982.title: A polyoxomolybdate-based hybrid nano capsule as an antineoplastic agent†
pmc-10628982.creator: Arti Joshi, Sobhna Acharya, Neeta Devi, Ruby Gupta, Deepika Sharma, Monika Singh
pmc-10628982.description: Polyoxometalates (POMs) are versatile anionic clusters which have attracted a lot of attention in biomedical investigations. To counteract the increasing resistance effect of cancer cells and the high toxicity of chemotherapeutic treatments, POM-based metallodrugs can be strategically synthesized by adjusting the stereochemical and physicochemical features of POMs.

pmc-11304991.title: Exploring the Origins and Evolution of Oxygenic and Anoxygenic Photosynthesis in Deeply Branched Cyanobacteriota
pmc-11304991.creator: Sha Tan, Lan Liu, Jian-Yu Jiao, Meng-Meng Li, Chao-Jian Hu, Ai-Ping Lv, Yan-Ling Qi, Yu-Xian Li, Yang-Zhi Rao, Yan-Ni Qu, Hong-Chen Jiang, Rochelle M Soo, Paul N Evans, Zheng-Shuang Hua, Wen-Jun Li
pmc-11304991.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cyanobacteriota, the sole prokaryotes capable of oxygenic photosynthesis (OxyP), occupy a unique and pivotal role in Earth's history. While the notion that OxyP may have originated from Cyanobacteriota is widely accepted, its early evolution remains elusive. Here, by using both metagenomics and metatranscriptomics, we explore 36 metagenome-assembled genomes from hot spring ecosystems, belonging to two deep-branching cyanobacterial orders: Thermostichales and Gloeomargaritales. Functional investigation reveals that Thermostichales encode the crucial thylakoid membrane biogenesis protein, vesicle-inducing protein in plastids 1 (Vipp1).

pmc-11657707.title: Pilot introduction of long-lasting insecticidal nets and hammock nets in the indigenous Comarca of Guna Yala, Panama
pmc-11657707.creator: A Oscar E González, Carmen Perez, Tania Blanco, Cipriano Ayarza, Santiago Chérigo, Mario Ávila, Lucía Fernández Montoya, Nicholas A Presley, Bernardo García Espinosa, Mariela Mosquera Renteria
pmc-11657707.description: BackgroundAfter almost 70 years of using indoor residual spraying (IRS) as the primary intervention for malaria vector control, the Republic of Panama wanted to evaluate the operational feasibility and acceptability of distributing long-lasting insecticidal hammock nets (LLIHNs) and long-lasting insecticidal nets (LLINs) in the country.

pmc-11848367.title: THE IDEAL MEDICAL STUDENT: THE NIGERIAN TRAINEES PERSPECTIVE
pmc-11848367.creator: SV Eweje, KI Egbuchulem, O Oladosu, OS Izevbekhai, AJ Temabor, SO Oluwalana, S Alawode, MM Awodiji, DI Olulana
pmc-11848367.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction:Medical school serves as a training ground and entry path to the dignified profession of medical practice. As a result, the training is rigorous, wholesome and exhaustive. It aims to raise students who are capable of handling the pressure associated with being a physician, equipped with the knowledge and critical thinking skills required to successfully manage patients as well as the discipline, strength and character needed to uphold the tenets expected of a physician.

pmc-12514216.title: Magnitude and predictors of mild cognitive impairment among older populations in Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12514216.creator: Sintayehu Asnakew, Jessica Nealon, Ayele Semachew Kasa, Gashaw Walle Ayehu, Dejen Getaneh Feleke, Tigabu Munye Aytenew, Victoria Traynor
pmc-12514216.description: BackgroundWith an increasingly older population, age-related health issues such as mild cognitive impairment and dementia are serious public health concerns. Emerging data suggest that public health and preventative intervention strategies can modify early risk factors for the development of mild cognitive impairment and dementia. However, there is inadequate evidence of mild cognitive impairment in older populations in Africa.

pmc-12653612.title: The Fine Structure of Genome Statistics—The Frequency and Size
pmc-12653612.creator: Piotr H. Pawłowski, Piotr Zielenkiewicz
pmc-12653612.description: A determination and mathematical analysis of the statistics of gene numbers in genomes was proposed. It establishes sampling ranges and provides an analytical description of the probability density function, which represents the likelihood of the number of genes in sequenced genomes falling within a specific range of values.

pmc-12660665.title: Hierarchical reasoning for lung cancer detection: from multi-scale perception to hypergraph inference with CR-YOLO
pmc-12660665.creator: Zhengshui Xu, Tianle Shen, Changchun Ye, Yu Li, Danwen Zhao, Ming Zhang, Yao Cheng, Jintao Chai, Jiantao Jiang, Junfeng Xi, Chao Xu, Wei Chen, Shiyuan Liu
pmc-12660665.description: Accurate detection of lung cancer from Computed Tomography (CT) scans is vital for improving patient survival but remains challenging for deep learning models, which struggle with scale variations of pulmonary nodules and the complex reasoning required for diagnosis. We propose CR-YOLO, a novel framework incorporating a Cognitive Reasoning C2f (CR-C2f) module that emulates a radiologist’s hierarchical workflow.

pmc-12716362.title: Cervical Diffuse Idiopathic Skeletal Hyperostosis (DISH) as an Underrecognized Cause of Dysphagia: A Case Series and Review of the Literature
pmc-12716362.creator: Emmanouela Dionysia Laskaratou, Ioannis Sperelakis, Nikolaos Trygonis, Rozalia Dimitriou, Georgios Kontakis
pmc-12716362.description: Diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis (DISH) represents an uncommon but clinically significant cause of secondary dysphagia. Ιn this paper, we report three elderly male patients presenting with progressive dysphagia secondary to cervical DISH. Diagnostic imaging confirmed prominent anterior cervical osteophytes at C3-C5. All patients underwent successful anterior osteophyte excision with complete symptom resolution.

pmc-12831535.title: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) and Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM)-Based Fabrication of Andrews Bridge for Comprehensive Rehabilitation of Seibert Class III Ridge Defect: A Case Report
pmc-12831535.creator: Deepesh Saxena, Tarannum Jindal
pmc-12831535.description: Alveolar ridge defects, especially Seibert Class III with combined horizontal and vertical loss, pose challenges in achieving optimal esthetics, function, and hygiene. The Andrews bridge, a hybrid fixed-removable prosthesis, offers an effective solution by combining the stability of a fixed component with the hygiene accessibility of a removable one.

pmc-13020051.title: “Medical refuge – To make you feel at home”☆
pmc-13020051.creator: Armando Manuel Mesquita Felgueiras, Cleópatra David Almada Andrade, Catarina Portugal Gaspar, Gonçalo Espírito Santo Matos, Eduarda Daniela Araújo Moreira, Frederica Josefa de Nóbrega Passos Teixeira Barbizani, Madalena Cabral Ferreira, Ricardo Jorge Ferreira da Silva
pmc-13020051.description: BackgroundThe armed conflict in Ukraine, which began in 2022, put millions of citizens at risk and triggered a severe humanitarian crisis. Medical Refuge was a project that consisted of primary health care appointments for refugees from various countries, in the Lisbon Metropolitan Area (Almada and Seixal).

pmc-13065863.title: Ranula vs. Atypical Sublingual Branchial Cleft Cyst: A Case Report
pmc-13065863.creator: Saleh Mohebbi, Fatemeh Abedin, Sahar Zahedi, Mehdi Abrishami
pmc-13065863.description: Congenital cystic lesions in the floor of the mouth in infants present significant diagnostic challenges owing to overlapping clinical and radiological features. We report a rare case of a one‐year‐old boy with a gradually enlarging, painless left sublingual swelling noticed since birth.

pmc-13143521.title: Molecular Characterization of Factor VIII Gene Variants in Hemophilia A: A Genotype-Haplotype Study from Eastern and Northern-Central India
pmc-13143521.creator: Chanda Hemaliya, Arun Kumar Singh, Anju Bharti, Akhtar Ali, Lalit Prashant Meena
pmc-13143521.description: RationaleHemophilia A is an X-linked recessive bleeding disorder caused by a deficiency or dysfunction of factor VIII (FVIII), affecting approximately 1 in 5,000 males globally, including those in northern India. Accurate carrier detection is vital for genetic counseling and early diagnosis.

pmc-13418764.title: Identification of adaptive selection footprints and adaptation strategies of hulless barley (Hordeum vulgare var. coeleste) on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau
pmc-13418764.creator: Tongrui Chen, Jinqing Xu, Lei Wang, Handong Wang, Yawen Gan, En You, Haiyan Bian, Youlin Tang, Chao Deng, Lu Lu, Yihang Wang, Yan Yang, Luobu Zhaxi, Yuhu Shen
pmc-13418764.description: BackgroundAfter millennia of cultivation on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP), hulless barley has developed remarkable adaptability. Decoding its genomic adaptive variations is crucial for elucidating the mechanisms underlying its plateau adaptation.ResultsIn this study, Genotyping 500 barley accessions generated 12,151 SNPs, revealing two major groups with geographic subdivisions.
